referents.why: 'Of Him' (αὐτοῦ) is the possessor of 'glory'; the glory is God's, so the referent is God.
Interrogative 'why' (τί) in the consequent question; no referent.
'Also I' (κἀγώ) is the imagined objector speaking in the diatribe; no candidate is the objector.
referents.category: voice of imagined objector not offered

links.why: Direction reversed: the consequent question cl0 is what the condition cl1 governs, so the link runs from cl0 to cl1.
The καί in cl0 is 'also' inside κἀγώ, not a conjunction joining the two clauses; the εἰ governs the consequence.
links.category: also read as and between clauses

links.why: The question 'why am I still judged as a sinner?' is conditioned by 'if the truth of God abounded in my lie'.

groups.why: The condition is cl1 and the consequence is cl0; the grouping is right, only the link direction was wrong.

cant_tell.why: The imagined objector is not a candidate; the 'I' is the voice of the diatribe's objection, not a person in the passage.
A verse-opening 'but' has no host in its verse, so no contrast link is drawn.
